definitions.label: processed `capacity` = raw `summary.discharge_capacity_Ah` (Ah; the library function get_capacity() takes the 2nd field of the summary struct)
definitions.stage_split: each cycle is split by relative_time_min == 0 into [charge, rest, discharge, rest] (Batch-6 satellite data has only 3 segments: charge/rest/discharge) -- from the publisher preprocessing library get_partial_value()
definitions.CC: in the charge stage, data with voltage <= 4.199 V **and** current >= 3.9 A (get_CC_value() default params: with voltage_range=None the condition is voltage<=4.199, then intersected with current>=3.9. library comment: the CV-stage voltage is sometimes below 4.199, hence the intersection with current)
definitions.CV: in the charge stage, data with voltage >= 4.199 V (get_CV_value() default params: with current_range=None it selects by voltage>=4.199; **it is not the complement of CC**. When current_range is passed it selects by current range instead)
definitions.source: github.com/wang-fujin/Battery-dataset-preprocessing-code-library/XJTUBatteryClass.py@e986a74054fb64c0f5134f2cc97f4643cd7699d2 (pinned by commit on 2026-09-23; the "V>=4.199 and I>3.9" recorded in v1 above was a mis-transcription and has been corrected against the publisher source; this repository does not redistribute it)
definitions.caveat: the above are the publisher's **default definitions of the code functions**; the processed CSV column names (CC Q / CV Q / CC charge time / CV charge time) are still not numerically aligned with that default definition (bexp62 column-by-column cross-check gives the measured comparison: the published CV column can be reproduced on the "charge-stage tail with current<=0.5A", while the CC column window rule is not public). This project's curve features always use a self-defined frozen window and do not pretend to be the publisher's definition.
definitions.mit_units: MIT struct: t is in minutes; I is **relative current (1C = 1.1 Ah rated)** -- measured dQc/(I*dt*60) median = 1.1000 (p10/p90 = 1.088/1.118, battery-1 cycle 10); after multiplying by the rated capacity the charge/discharge integrals close with QCharge/QDischarge to within 0.1% (measured 2026-09-23)

units_direction.XJTU: current_A charge positive, discharge negative (sample_cycle_0 measured per file)
units_direction.MIT:
I charge positive, discharge negative; t in minutes; I is relative current (1C=1.1 Ah) --
measured dQc/(I*dt*60)=1.1000 (battery-1 c10); after scaling by the rated capacity Qc/Qd close to 0.1%

release_gate.rule: B2 (bexp63/65) excludes cells with identity_status != pass; C (bexp64) additionally requires row_level_mapping=True; bexp62 cross-check uses only row-alignable (row_level_mapping) cells.
